page_text_ocr_zh: 青蛙弗洛格正在吃早餐。“今天是一个非常特别的日子！”他激动地想。野兔昨天这么说的，可今天为什么特别，弗洛格就不明白了。
page_text_en: Frog Floppy is eating breakfast. "Today is a very special day!" he thought excitedly. Rabbit said that yesterday, but why today is special, Floppy didn't understand.
summary_zh: 青蛙弗洛格正在吃早餐，他想起野兔说今天是特别的日子，但不明白具体特别在哪里。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“‘非常特别’到底是什么意思呢？”弗洛格沉思着，
“肯定有什么奇妙的事情会发生！”
page_text_en:
"What does 'very special' actually mean?" Frog thought, 
"Something wonderful is sure to happen!"
summary_zh: 弗洛格在家中沉思，思考‘非常特别’的含义，并期待着奇妙的事情发生。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他出了门。阳光明媚，万里无云，天气暖融融的。可是，这也没什么特别的呀！昨天也是这样，昨天的昨天也是这样，昨天的昨天的昨天还是这样。弗洛格决定去问问鸭子。
page_text_en: He went out the door. The sun was bright, the sky was clear, and the weather was warm and cozy. But still, there was nothing special! Yesterday was like this, the day before yesterday was like this, and even the day before that was still like this. Frog decided to go ask Duck.
summary_zh: 弗洛格出门后发现天气晴好，但觉得与往常无异，于是决定去问鸭子今天特别在哪里。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“鸭子，今天是什么日子？”
“我想想……”鸭子说，“今天是星期五。不！等
等……好像是星期三……也可能是星期二。”
“有什么特别的吗？”弗洛格问道。
“没有。”鸭子回答说，“今天就是今天。”
page_text_en:
"Duck, what day is it today?"
"Let me think..." said Duck, "Today is Friday. No! Wait... it seems to be Wednesday... or maybe Tuesday."
"Is there anything special?" asked Frog.
"No," replied Duck, "Today is today."
summary_zh: 弗洛格询问鸭子今天是什么特别的日子，鸭子表示自己也搞不清楚具体是星期几，认为今天和往常一样，没有特别之处。

page_text_ocr_zh: “蠢鸭子！”弗洛格心想，“糊涂蛋一个，什么都不知道！”可能小猪知道得会多一些。小猪什么都知道。
page_text_en: "Stupid duck!" Frog thought, "A complete fool, doesn't know anything!" Maybe Pig knows a bit more. Pig knows everything.
summary_zh: 弗洛格对鸭子的回答感到失望，认为鸭子糊涂，于是决定去问小猪，因为小猪知道得更多。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“小猪，今天是什么日子？”
“是洗衣服啊！”小猪回答说，“我得洗床单、枕套，还有所有的衣服。要我帮你洗游泳裤吗？”
“噢，不用了，谢谢！”弗洛格说，“但是，小猪，难道……没有什么……嗯……特别的吗？”
“据我所知，没有。”
page_text_en:
"Pig, what day is it today?"
"It's laundry day!" Pig replied, "I have to wash the sheets, pillowcases, and all your clothes. Shall I wash your swimming trunks too?"
"Oh, no thanks!" said Frog, "But Pig, is there... nothing... uh... special?"
"As far as I know, no."
summary_zh: 弗洛格去问小猪今天是什么特别的日子，小猪正在洗衣服，表示今天是洗衣服的日子，但并不认为有什么特别之处。

summary_zh: 弗洛格因未能找到今天特别之处而感到失望，他不高兴地走出家门，心里疑惑野兔所说的‘特别的日子’到底是什么意思。

At this moment, the mouse walked over, carrying a big bag of things on his shoulder.
"Mouse!" Frog called out, "Is there anything special today?"
"Of course!" the mouse replied, "Every day is special! Look around you, the world is so beautiful! Everything in life is unique."

summary_zh: 弗洛格坐在草地上伤心哭泣，他发现野兔所说的‘特别的日子’原来是指聚会，但野兔没有邀请他，因此他感到被忽视和生气。

page_text_ocr_zh:
学会热爱生活
家人和朋友有时会制造一些小惊喜，这会给你的生活带来许多快乐。他们都是你生命中最最宝贵的财富。学会感恩，学会珍惜亲情、友情，珍爱生活，并把你拥有的快乐传递给更多的人。

想一想
1. 弗洛格吃早餐的时候想到了什么？
2. 弗洛格回到家看到了什么？
3. 今天为什么是特别的一天？

试一试
家人或朋友过生日的时候，做点什么让他们感到惊喜和快乐呢？别忘了对他们说声“谢谢”，感谢他们也给你带来了快乐和幸福。
page_text_en:
Learn to Love Life
Family and friends sometimes create little surprises, which can bring much joy to your life. They are the most precious treasures in your life. Learn to be grateful, cherish family bonds and friendships, love life, and pass on the happiness you have to more people.

Think About It
1. What did Frog think about when he had breakfast?
2. What did Frog see when he got home?
3. Why was today a special day?

Try This
When family or friends have a birthday, what can you do to make them feel surprised and happy? Don't forget to say "thank you" to them, and thank them for bringing you joy and happiness too.

“弗洛格又出现的日子，就是最最特别的日子。”

这是一套有助于孩子心灵成长的心理教育故事。每个故事都自然流露出某种重要的主题，充满了想象力。文图都是马克斯·维尔修思创作的，文字透着生动和浅浅的幽默，图画则是鲜有的简笔画风格，被西方艺术家誉为“简笔画世界的杰作”。目前该系列已经被翻译成38种语言，全球销量逾百万册。

Author Max Velthuijs is a highly acclaimed children's illustrator internationally.
This series has won the Dutch Golden Pencil Award, the French Prix de Treize Award, the German Bestlist Award, and the American Graphic Award.

"The day Frog appears again is the most special day."
— Book collector Jane Donahue

This is a series of psychological education stories that help children's mental growth. Each story naturally reveals an important theme and is full of imagination. Both text and illustrations are created by Max Velthuijs. The writing is lively and subtly humorous, while the illustrations feature a unique simple-line style, hailed by Western artists as 'a masterpiece of simple-line art'. The series has been translated into 38 languages and has sold over a million copies worldwide.
